snippet.title: Version 2.0 Teaser "Where Clouds Embrace the Dawn" | Zenless Zone Zero
snippet.description:
Where the mind flows, all things become clear.
Impurities fade away, leaving no trace, no shadow.
Peace returns to the land of Waifei.
"If only she hadn't broken her promise to me on that day when the old capital fell..."

✨ Log in during Version 2.0 to select your standard S-Rank Agent and W-Engine! Pre-register for Version 2.0 and get 320 Polychromes: 
https://hoyo.link/oKb6Sp7qW

—Welcome to New Eridu!—
